events.cause: Yawing the turbine into the wind took too long
events.rectification: Is there a problem with (one of) the yaw motors ? Alternatively, it is possible that the wind direction changed too much while yawing had started

events.cause: One of the protection switches F7-F10 of the yaw motors has tripped
events.rectification: Visually inspect yaw mechanism for obstruction / damage. Switch on F7-F10 in nacelle control box 540A001.

events.cause: The maintenance switch S1 of the yaw motors on nacelle control box 540A001 is “off” while the turbine has been started
events.rectification: Switch on the yaw motors maintenance switch S1 on nacelle control box 540A001

events.cause: The cable has been wind up too much, without an adequate cable unwind command from the control system.
events.rectification: Visually inspect the cable. Unwind the cable with the YAW LEFT or RIGHT button on the nacelle control box.

events.cause: The I/O module has sensed a broken wire
events.rectification: Check wiring from twist sensor. Check potentiometer value (4.7 kOhm)

events.cause: The pressure of the hydraulic power unit has dropped 25% below nominal value (< 150 bar)
events.rectification: Check hydraulic power unit. Check yaw brakes for leakage. Fix leakage.

events.cause: The I/O module has sensed a broken wire
events.rectification: Check wiring to the hydraulic pressure sensor

events.cause: The wind meter signal is lost, or does not match with the current rotor speed
events.rectification: Check wiring to wind meter. Visually inspect wind meter for icing / damage (are all cups still present ?)

events.cause: Wind vane 1 signal frozen for more than 1 minute while V > 4.0 wind,1 min. avg m/s
events.rectification: Check wiring to wind vane 1. Check wind vane 1 for icing / damage / obstruction.

events.cause: Wind vane 2 signal frozen for more than 1 minute while V > 4.0 wind,1 min. avg m/s
events.rectification: Check wiring to wind vane 2. Check wind vane 2 for icing / damage / obstruction.

events.cause: Filtered values (T=25s) of wind vane 1 and wind vane 2 differ by more than 15˚ while 10 min. avg. wind speed > 4.5 m/s
events.rectification: Check wind vanes. Is one of the vanes bent ?

events.cause: Loss of power to the obstruction lights controller or the controller has detected a strobe fail condition: 1) Flashhead has missed 4 or more consecutive flashes (=flash fail) 2) System flashing at wrong intensity step (=all photocell fail) 3) Missing flashhead station (=missing station)
events.rectification: Check power to the obstruction lights controller. Check wiring to flashheads. Check that flashheads have different station number after replacement. See also [Orga]

events.cause: During very high wind speeds, cable unwinding is inhibited.
An emergency system check is conducted.

The result of the most recent overspeed test is successful

events.text: Rotor PLC CAN node not operational
events.cause: The communication link between rotor remote I/O PLC station and the nacelle remote I/O PLC station is not operational.
events.rectification: Check availability of power to the rotor: is F14 in nacelle control box 540A001 tripped ? Check communication cable over slip ring. Check polarity of communication cable. Check presence of CAN termination resistors in nacelle control box 540A001 and rotor control box 541A001. If link is operational, the green RUN LED on the CS200/N module of the rotor remote I/O PLC is blinking. If the green RUN LED is off or is lighting constantly the link is not operational !

events.cause: The communication link between SBP loader of blade 1 and the nacelle remote I/O PLC station is not operational.
events.rectification: Check availability of power to the SBP loader 1. Check communication cable over slip ring. Check polarity of communication cable. Check presence of CAN termination resistors in nacelle control box 540A001 and rotor control box 541A001. Check SBP loader station number on cover after replacement.

events.cause: The communication link between SBP loader of blade 2 and the nacelle remote I/O PLC station is not operational.
events.rectification: Check availability of power to the SBP loader 2. Check communication cable over slip ring. Check polarity of communication cable. Check presence of CAN termination resistors in nacelle control box 540A001 and rotor control box 541A001. Check SBP loader station number on cover after replacement.

events.cause: The communication link between SBP loader of blade 3 and the nacelle remote I/O PLC station is not operational.
events.rectification: Check availability of power to the SBP loader 3. Check communication cable over slip ring. Check polarity of communication cable. Check presence of CAN termination resistors in nacelle control box 540A001 and rotor control box 541A001. Check SBP loader station number on cover after replacement.

events.cause: The emergency pitch system is activated, but not by the PLC system. This can be caused by a trip of the external Jaquet overspeed relay or a watchdog timeout.
events.rectification: Read peak speed measurement from the Zoom/Rotor/Test Overspeed Trip screen on Local Operator Panel. Reset peak speed. Visually inspect the hub for damage, and if possible try to download a high resolution logging of the event to send to Harakosan.

events.cause: The DRIVE HEALTHY contact of the Control Techniques Maxi Maestro drive of blade 1 was lost. This indicates either: -DC link voltage not OK -Drive temperature not OK
events.rectification: Verify resistance of braking resistor (8 Ohm). See also [Control techniques]. If problems persist or drive fault frequency is high, replace drive and return faulty for investigation.

events.cause: The DRIVE HEALTHY contact of the Control Techniques Maxi Maestro drive of blade 2 was lost. This indicates either: -DC link voltage not OK -Drive temperature not OK
events.rectification: Verify resistance of braking resistor (8 Ohm). See also [Control techniques]. If problems persist or drive fault frequency is high, replace drive and return faulty for investigation.

events.cause: The DRIVE HEALTHY contact of the Control Techniques Maxi Maestro drive of blade 3 was lost. This indicates either: -DC link voltage not OK -Drive temperature not OK
events.rectification: Verify resistance of braking resistor (8 Ohm). See also [Control techniques]. If problems persist or drive fault frequency is high, replace drive and return faulty for investigation.

events.cause: The blade angle measured with the encoder of blade 1 is outside range
events.rectification: Check wiring to the encoder of blade 1. Check encoder calibration.

events.cause: The blade angle measured with the encoder of blade 2 is outside range
events.rectification: Check wiring to the encoder of blade 2. Check encoder calibration.

events.cause: The blade angle measured with the encoder of blade 3 is outside range
events.rectification: Check wiring to the encoder of blade 3. Check encoder calibration.

events.cause: The movement of blade 1 to the target position takes longer than expected.
events.rectification: Check pitch bearing blade 1 for smooth movement. Is greasing OK ?

events.cause: The movement of blade 2 to the target position takes longer than expected.
events.rectification: Check pitch bearing blade 2 for smooth movement. Is greasing OK ?

events.cause: The movement of blade 3 to the target position takes longer than expected.
events.rectification: Check pitch bearing blade 3 for smooth movement. Is greasing OK ?

events.cause: The ECM module feedback indicates that the emergency system of blade 1 has been activated.
events.rectification: Automatic reset when emergency trip condition is cleared

events.cause: The ECM module feedback indicates that the emergency system of blade 2 has been activated.
events.rectification: Automatic reset when emergency trip condition is cleared

events.cause: The ECM module feedback indicates that the emergency system of blade 3 has been activated.
events.rectification: Automatic reset when emergency trip condition is cleared

events.cause: The synchronisation between blades 1 and 2 is lost, resulting in unbalance of the rotor (instantly > 8 deg, during 3 sec. > 3 deg or during 5 sec. > 1 deg)
events.rectification: Are pitch drives 1 and 2 OK ? Check pitch bearing blades 1 and 2 for smooth adjustment. Is greasing OK ? Are there significant differences in current of the blades on screen Zoom/Rotor/Pitch drive inverters ? Is the I2t protection of blade 1 or blade 2 activated frequently ?

events.cause: The synchronisation between blades 1 and 3 is lost, resulting in unbalance of the rotor. (instantly > 8 deg, during 3 sec. > 3 deg or during 5 sec. > 1 deg)
events.rectification: Are pitch drives 1 and 3 OK ? Is I2t protection blade 1 active ? Check pitch bearing blades 1 and 3 for smooth adjustment. Is greasing OK ? Are there significant differences in current of the blades on screen Zoom/Rotor/Pitch drive inverters ? Is the I2t protection of blade 1 or blade 3 activated frequently ?

events.cause: The synchronisation between blades 2 and 3 is lost, resulting in unbalance of the rotor. (instantly > 8 deg, during 3 sec. > 3 deg or during 5 sec. > 1 deg)
events.rectification: Are pitch drives 2 and 3 OK ? Check pitch bearing blades 2 and 3 for smooth adjustment. Is greasing OK ? Are there significant differences in current of the blades on screen Zoom/Rotor/Pitch drive inverters ? Is the I2t protection of blade 2 or blade 3 activated frequently ?

events.cause: The DC battery maintenance switch on the rotor cabinet has not been set to the normal “Off” position. The turbine start-up is blocked, because the emergency pitch system is not armed.
events.rectification: Put DC maintenance switch on rotor cabinet to “Off” position. Note: On = Service on / Batteries disconnected Off = Service off / Batteries connected

events.cause: The pitch control system was unable to keep the rotor speed inside it’s normal operating range
events.rectification: Read peak speed measurement from Local Operator Panel screen Zoom/Rotor/Test Overspeed Trip. Reset peak speed. If this trip occurs too often, the parameters of the pitch control system may have to be fine-tuned. Contact Harakosan for investigation.

events.cause: The result of an overspeed test was not successful
events.rectification: Check peak speed at Local Operator Panel screen Zoom/Rotor/Test overspeed Trip. Was rotor peak speed below 10.0 rpm ? Otherwise, do not restart turbine !

events.cause: The voltage of the control voltage of the emergency pitch system battery of blade 1 has decreased below the level where the emergency relay is assumed to work properly. The battery is worn out, the SBP loader of blade 1 is not functioning properly or a connection is lost.
events.rectification: Check connector connection XB1 of Rotor Control Box 541A001. Check connector of battery pack to SBP loader of blade 1. Check if power is available on SBP 1 loader. Check voltage of 24 Vdc section of battery. Replace battery if battery is worn out.

events.cause: The voltage of the control voltage of the emergency pitch system battery of blade 2 has decreased below the level where the emergency relay is assumed to work properly. The battery is worn out, the SBP loader of blade 1 is not functioning properly or a connection is lost.
events.rectification: Check connector connection XB1 of Rotor Control Box 541A001. Check connector of battery pack to SBP loader of blade 2. Check if power is available on SBP 2 loader. Check voltage of 24 Vdc section of battery. Replace battery if battery is worn out.

events.cause: The voltage of the control voltage of the emergency pitch system battery of blade 3 has decreased below the level where the emergency relay is assumed to work properly. The battery is worn out, the SBP loader of blade 1 is not functioning properly or a connection is lost.
events.rectification: Check connector connection XB1 of Rotor Control Box 541A001. Check connector of battery pack to SBP loader of blade 3. Check if power is available on SBP 3 loader. Check voltage of 24 Vdc section of battery. Replace battery if battery is worn out.

events.text: Blade 1 emergency pitch speed very low
events.cause: The emergency pitch speed of blade 1 measured during the last emergency system check is below the set level of 4 deg/s. The battery is worn out, the SBP loader of blade 1 is not functioning properly or a connection is lost
events.rectification: Check connector of battery pack to SBP loader of blade 1. Check if power is available on SBP 1 loader. Check voltage of 168 Vdc section of battery. Replace battery if battery voltage < 140 Vdc. Is greasing blade 1 OK ?

events.text: Blade 2 emergency pitch speed very low
events.cause: The emergency pitch speed of blade 2 measured during the last emergency system check is below the set level of 4 deg/s. The battery is worn out, the SBP loader of blade 2 is not functioning properly or a connection is lost
events.rectification: Check connector of battery pack to SBP loader of blade 2. Check if power is available on SBP 2 loader. Check voltage of 168 Vdc section of battery. Replace battery if battery voltage < 140 Vdc. Is greasing blade 2 OK ?

events.text: Blade 3 emergency pitch speed very low
events.cause: The emergency pitch speed of blade 3 measured during the last emergency system check is below the set level of 4 deg/s. The battery is worn out, the SBP loader of blade 3 is not functioning properly or a connection is lost
events.rectification: Check connector of battery pack to SBP loader of blade 3. Check if power is available on SBP 3 loader. Check voltage of 168 Vdc section of battery. Replace battery if battery voltage < 140 Vdc. Is greasing blade 3 OK ?

events.cause: The time to reach vane position for all blades exceeded 2 x expected pitch time
